pairs: And so Hezekiah began to reign when he was twenty-five years old.
And he reigned for twenty-nine years in Jerusalem.
et viginti novem annis regnavit in Jerusalem:
The name of his mother was Abijah,
nomen matris ejus Abia filia Zachariæ.
Fecitque quod erat placitum in conspectu Domini,
And he did what was pleasing in the sight of the Lord,
juxta omnia quæ fecerat David pater ejus.
in accord with all that his father David had done.
anno et mense primo regni sui,
he opened the double doors of the house of the Lord,
And he brought together the priests and Levites.
et congregavit eos in plateam orientalem.
And he gathered them in the wide eastern street.
mundate domum Domini Dei patrum vestrorum,
Cleanse the house of the Lord, the God of your fathers,
et auferte omnem immunditiam de sanctuario.
and take away every uncleanness from the sanctuary.
et fecerunt malum in conspectu Domini Dei nostri,
and did evil in the sight of the Lord our God,
averterunt facies suas a tabernaculo Domini,
They turned their faces away from the tabernacle of the Lord,
Clauserunt ostia quæ erant in porticu,
They closed up the doors which were in the portico,
And they did not burn incense,
et holocausta non obtulerunt in sanctuario Deo Israël.
and they did not offer holocausts, in the sanctuary of the God of Israel.
Concitatus est itaque furor Domini super Judam et Jerusalem,
And so the fury of the Lord was stirred up against Judah and Jerusalem,
and he handed them over to turmoil,
just as you discern with your own eyes.
our fathers have fallen by the sword.
et conjuges captivæ ductæ sunt propter hoc scelus.
and our daughters and wives have been led away as captives because of this wickedness.
Nunc ergo placet mihi ut ineamus fœdus cum Domino Deo Israël,
Now therefore, it is pleasing to me that we should enter into a covenant with the Lord, the God of Israel.
et avertet a nobis furorem iræ suæ.
And he will turn away the fury of his indignation from us.
do not choose to be negligent.
vos elegit Dominus ut stetis coram eo,
The Lord has chosen you so that you would stand before him,
et Joël filius Azariæ de filiis Caath:
and Joel, the son of Azariah, from the sons of Kohath;
then, from the sons of Merari,
and Azariah, the son of Jehallelel;
and from the sons of Gershon,
and Eden, the son of Joah;
And they gathered together their brothers.
et ingressi sunt juxta mandatum regis et imperium Domini,
And they entered in accord with the command of the king and the order of the Lord,
so that they might expiate the house of God.
Sacerdotes quoque ingressi templum Domini ut sanctificarent illud,
And the priests, entering the temple of the Lord so that they might sanctify it,
extulerunt omnem immunditiam quam intro repererant in vestibulo domus Domini:
took every uncleanness, which they had found inside, out to the vestibule of the house of the Lord;
quam tulerunt Levitæ, et asportaverunt ad torrentem Cedron foras.
and the Levites took it away and transported it outside, to the torrent Kidron.
Cœperunt autem prima die mensis primi mundare,
Now they began to cleanse on the first day of the first month.
et in die octavo ejusdem mensis ingressi sunt porticum templi Domini,
And on the eighth day of the same month,
they entered the portico of the temple of the Lord.
et in die sextadecima mensis ejusdem,
And then they expiated the temple over eight days.
And on the sixteenth day of the same month,
they finished what they had begun.
Ingressi quoque sunt ad Ezechiam regem,
Also, they entered to king Hezekiah,
“We have sanctified the entire house of the Lord,
necnon et mensam propositionis cum omnibus vasis suis,
indeed also the table of the presence, with all its vessels,
and all the equipment of the temple,
quam polluerat rex Achaz in regno suo,
which king Ahaz, during his reign,
et ecce exposita sunt omnia coram altare Domini.
And behold, these have all been set forth before the altar of the Lord.”
And rising up at first light,
king Hezekiah joined as one all the leaders of the city,
and they ascended to the house of the Lord.
And together they offered seven bulls and seven rams,
And he spoke to the priests,
so that they would offer these upon the altar of the Lord.
And so they slaughtered the bulls.
And the priests took up the blood,
and they poured it upon the altar.
Then they also slaughtered the rams,
et illorum sanguinem super altare fuderunt,
and they poured their blood upon the altar.
and they poured the blood upon the altar.
Applicuerunt hircos pro peccato coram rege,
They brought the he-goats for sin before the king
And they laid their hands upon them.
et asperserunt sanguinem eorum coram altare pro piaculo universi Israëlis:
and they sprinkled their blood before the altar,
pro omni quippe Israël præceperat rex ut holocaustum fieret,
for the expiation of all Israel.
For certainly the king had instructed that the holocaust and the sin offering should be made on behalf of all Israel.
Constituit quoque Levitas in domo Domini cum cymbalis,
Also, he situated the Levites in the house of the Lord, with cymbals,
et citharis secundum dispositionem David regis,
and harps, according to the disposition of king David,
siquidem Domini præceptum fuit per manum prophetarum ejus.
For indeed, this was the precept of the Lord, by the hand of his prophets.
And the Levites stood, holding the musical instruments of David,
and the priests held the trumpets.
Et jussit Ezechias ut offerrent holocausta super altare:
And Hezekiah ordered that they should offer holocausts upon the altar.
And when the holocausts were being offered,
they began to sing praises to the Lord,
atque in diversis organis quæ David rex Israël præparaverat,
and to play various musical instruments, which David, the king of Israel,
Then the entire crowd was adoring,
and those who were holding the trumpeters were exercising their office,
erant in officio suo donec compleretur holocaustum.
And when the oblation was finished,
et omnes qui erant cum eo,
and all who were with him,
And Hezekiah and the rulers instructed the Levites to praise the Lord with the words of David,
And they praised him with great joy,
“You have filled your hands for the Lord.
et offerte victimas et laudes in domo Domini.
and offer victims and praises in the house of the Lord.”
Obtulit ergo universa multitudo hostias, et laudes,
Therefore, the entire multitude offered victims and praises and holocausts,
Porro numerus holocaustorum quæ obtulit multitudo, hic fuit: tauros septuaginta,
Now the number of the holocausts that the multitude offered was seventy bulls,
And they sanctified to the Lord six hundred oxen
nec poterant sufficere ut pelles holocaustorum detraherent:
neither were they sufficient to remove the pelts from the holocausts. Therefore,
unde et Levitæ fratres eorum adjuverunt eos,
the Levites, their brothers, also assisted them,
and the priests, who were of higher rank,
Levitæ quippe faciliori ritu sanctificantur quam sacerdotes.
were sanctified. For indeed, the Levites are sanctified with an easier ritual than the priests.
with the fat of the peace offerings and the libations of the holocausts.
et completus est cultus domus Domini.
And the service of the house of the Lord was completed.
Lætatusque est Ezechias et omnis populus,
And Hezekiah and all the people were joyful because the ministry of the Lord was accomplished.
eo quod ministerium Domini esset expletum:
de repente quippe hoc fieri placuerat.
it had pleased them to do this suddenly.
